notes: 2018_00_link.txt is the FSU Parental Leave FAQ (Wayback capture 2019-10-21, undated); 2018_01_uff_cba_2016_2019.txt is the BOT-UFF Collective Bargaining Agreement 2016-2019 (ratified 2016, in force through 2019-06-30); 2018_02_faculty_handbook_2017.txt is the FSU Faculty Handbook 2017 (revised June 2017).

Governing documents: the CBA (Article 17 Leaves) governs in-unit faculty; the Handbook restates it ('Leave guidelines are in accordance with ... Article 17 (Leaves) of the BOT-UFF Collective Bargaining Agreement'). The FAQ (2018_00_link) is a summary, undated, captured October 2019 (outside the 2017-18 reference year): used only for details of provisions the CBA contains (concurrency of paid and unpaid parental leave, pay by FTE, modification of duties, tenure clock); components citing it carry version_uncertain.

Reference date 2018-02-22. Calendar: Handbook 'two semesters, each lasting approximately 15 weeks' -> term_weeks 15. The CBA's definition of a semester as 'approximately 19.5 week periods' is the contract/pay semester (R8: not a term length).

Paid parental leave (c2): 'not to exceed six (6) months', but 'Paid leave shall not be granted that relieves the faculty member of both teaching and service assignments for more than one semester' -> coded 1 semester (R16, whose example is this provision). The six-month span is in duration_note only.

Birth parent chain: unpaid parental leave up to 6 months (c1, from up to 2 weeks before the birth) containing the paid parental leave (c2, within c1, one semester of full relief) and accrued-leave pay (c10, within c1); FMLA 12 workweeks (c3) and FS 110.221 (c4) concurrent with c1; then part-time leave without pay up to 1 year (c5, consecutive_after c1). Sick leave for pregnancy disability (c8) is the employee's own balance, unlinked.

Non-birth parent chain: the same as the birth parent (c1 with c2 within it, FMLA concurrent, c5 after), except c8; the paid leave cannot be granted to two faculty members for the same birth. Family-illness sick leave (c9) is own balance, unlinked.

The bargaining unit (Appendix A) leaves out employees of the College of Law and the College of Medicine; arts and sciences and engineering faculty are in the unit, so CBA provisions are coded main_campus_tenure_stream (V3).

Not components: compulsory leave (17.8(c), imposed by the University), job-related illness (17.8(b)), sabbatical and professional development leave, phased-retirement leaves (retirees), bereavement, jury, military, disaster and athletic leaves (cannot be used for a birth).
